comparison.objective: Place an unscrewed reagent cap interior-up on a rest without contaminating protected surfaces.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate reorientation and release with continuous contact avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Cap rests interior-up without any contact to its interior or opening rim; forbidden contact is persistently latched.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is protected-surface handling and orientation, not forceful impact, sacrificial fracture, or free-fragment containment.
